newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Tong Yang group of Korea invests in Manila firm.
newsitem.headline: Tong Yang group of Korea invests in Manila firm.

text.p: Conglomerate Tong Yang group of Korea and two Philippine firms have invested in Crown Equities Inc to have a combined equity stake of 20 percent, Sergio Naranilla, Crown Equities executive vice president, said on Wednesday.
Crown Equities, a holding concern, recently completed a stock rights offering which raised 1.12 billion pesos.
Naranilla said one of the interests Crown Equities will be pursuing is health care.
Major shareholders of Crown Equities are George Go and Wilfrido Vergara, chairman and president respectively of Equitable Banking Corp.
